section_1.title: Prerequisites: The Geometry of a Tangent
section_1.content: Briefly introduce the tangent line as a linear approximation of a function at a point. Visual: A curve with a tangent line intersecting the x-axis.
section_1.example: Imagine a drone calculating its landing spot: it estimates the ground slope at its current hover point to predict where it will touch down.

section_2.title: Newton’s Method: The Iterative Search
section_2.content: Explain the formula x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n). Focus on the 'Refinement' logic: each tangent intersection gets closer to the true root.
section_2.example: A robotic arm finding the exact pressure point on a screen by repeatedly adjusting its position based on the slope of the glass resistance.

section_3.title: The Basin of Attraction
section_3.content: Explain that where you start (the 'initial guess') determines which root you find. Visual: A color-coded number line where different segments lead to different roots.
section_3.example: Three hungry foxes standing at different points in a forest; each one runs to the closest watering hole (root), but some start too far and get confused.

section_4.title: From Roots to Fractals: Newton's Fractal
section_4.content: Extend the search to the Complex Plane. If we color each initial guess based on which root it converges to, complex patterns emerge at the boundaries.
section_4.example: Visualizing the 'chaos' at the borders: zoom into a Newton Fractal for z^3 - 1 = 0, showing that even small changes in the starting position cause wild jumps between roots.

section_5.title: Conclusion and Intuition
section_5.content: Summarize how simple linear updates produce infinite complexity. Emphasize that chaos arises specifically where the 'basins' meet.
section_5.example: A compass navigating a magnetic field: the complexity of the fractal boundary is like the unpredictable turbulence a ship faces when caught between two opposing currents.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):

        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)

        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2

        self.play(Indicate(dot))

        self.play(dot.animate.move_to(line.n2p(1.5)), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(dot.animate.move_to(line.n2p(0)), run_time=1)

    def construct(self):

            "They predict where the curve crosses the axis.",

        self.play(Create(x0_point))

        # Tangent line (simplified approximation)
        # Point (x0, f(x0))
        f_x0 = 0.2*(x0_val-1)*(x0_val-3)*(x0_val-4) + 2
        # Slope (derivative approx)

            axes.c2p(x0_val-1, f_x0 - df_x0),
            axes.c2p(x0_val+1, f_x0 + df_x0),
            color=PURPLE
        )
        self.play(Create(tangent))
        
        # Intersection x1
        x1_val = x0_val - f_x0 / df_x0
        x1_point = Dot(axes.c2p(x1_val, 0), color=RED)
        self.play(Create(x1_point))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(RED))

            "This allows us to estimate roots numerically."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisites: The Geometry of a Tangent", lecture_lines)
        
        # Create function and axes
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-1, 5], y_range=[-1, 4], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.2*(x-1)*(x-3)*(x-4) + 2, color=WHITE)
        
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B1", "E6", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.add(axes, curve)
        
        # Elements for animation
        x0_val = 1.2
        x0_point = Dot(axes.c2p(x0_val, axes.p2y(axes.c2p(x0_val, 0)), 0), color=YELLOW)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Create(x0_point))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(ORANGE))
        
        # Tangent line (simplified approximation)
        # Point (x0, f(x0))
        f_x0 = 0.2*(x0_val-1)*(x0_val-3)*(x0_val-4) + 2
        # Slope (derivative approx)
        df_x0 = 0.6*x0_val**2 - 4*x0_val + 6.2
        
        tangent = Line(
            axes.c2p(x0_val-1, f_x0 - df_x0),
            axes.c2p(x0_val+1, f_x0 + df_x0),
            color=PURPLE
        )
        self.play(Create(tangent))
        
        # Intersection x1
        x1_val = x0_val - f_x0 / df_x0
        x1_point = Dot(axes.c2p(x1_val, 0), color=RED)
        self.play(Create(x1_point))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(RED))
        
        label_x0 = MathTex("x_0").next_to(x0_point, UP, buff=0.1)
        label_x1 = MathTex("x_1").next_to(x1_point, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.play(Write(label_x0), Write(label_x1))
        
        self.wait(2)
